scope: Fresh Ubuntu image guest qualification for source provisioning, synthetic setup/build/smoke, inert release staging and activation, reboot persistence, and ordinary-host package adapter behavior. This is QEMU TCG guest evidence, not bare-metal qualification.

private_source_acquisition.method: fresh depth-1 single-branch clone on the outer Aéza host using the read-only GitHub deploy-key alias, then transfer of that exact checkout into the guest over its separate loopback-only SSH control key

inert_service_host_role.official_image_initial_plan: empty; all fixed-role packages were already present
inert_service_host_role.controlled_fixture: dpkg removed only iproute2 with --force-depends after ordinary APT simulation showed a seven-package cascade
inert_service_host_role.recovery: PackageKit was manually stopped in the disposable guest; after reboot, iproute2 remained installed, preflight was ready, and a fresh empty plan/apply passed
inert_service_host_role.limitation: The service-host install path did not pass as inert; the adapter correctly failed closed after observing service activity.

qualification_precondition_gap.cause: The original package adapter matcher recognized names beginning with brain but omitted the actual memecoin-brain-<release-id>.service name.
qualification_precondition_gap.effect: The controlled service-role apply ran despite a staged Brain release unit being present. Treat it as an invalid qualification of the adapter's precondition boundary, while retaining its package and PackageKit observations as factual guest evidence.
qualification_precondition_gap.remediation: Both ordinary-host and lab unit matchers now recognize brain* and memecoin-brain-*; focused tests cover staged release names. The guest should refuse preflight after receiving this fix.

capabilities_after_setup.inert_service_host_ext4: indeterminate until a release unit is supplied
capabilities_after_setup.gpu: indeterminate; no NVIDIA device and CUDA unqualified

observations: The first guest session observed /dev/null mode 0644; a targeted udev change event restored 0666. It remained 0666 after the later reboot. The cause was not isolated.
APT policy-rc.d did not prevent PackageKit from becoming active during the controlled iproute2 installation. This is evidence that the guard is only a mitigation.
limitations: QEMU TCG guest, not a bare-metal Ubuntu qualification; the outer Aéza VPS was not a clean host.
Private GitHub credentials stayed on the outer brain account; the guest received only the clean source checkout and a separate temporary SSH control keypair.

Ordinary-host source-build apply and inert release lifecycle passed. The inert-service role's package-changing apply detected PackageKit activation and failed closed, but was run with a staged Brain release unit due to the matcher defect noted above; it does not qualify service-role apply preconditions. A no-op post-reboot apply passed before the fix.
No real durable Brain payload, Kingston content, Migration v1 candidate, protected dataset, provider secret, production runtime, GPU, or trading action was used.
